note: Wooded campground on the bluff top at Pikes Peak State Park near McGregor, inland from the overlook where the Mississippi and Wisconsin rivers meet; no river view from the sites. No daily Iowa park-entry fee. --Claude
summary: Not waterfront confirmed: no Near Water tag on any of the 57 sites, the loops sit in forest ~400 m inland from the bluff edge, and RA photos of the easternmost sites (47-53) show only woods. Changed sites 77 -> 57 (RA list), season year_round false -> true (RA 'Open year round'), added 50 A, 55-ft max, pull-throughs. Pin ~440 m off: moved to the GIS centroid.
flags: WATERFRONT: not waterfront confirmed. Every RA site is tagged 'Near Water - no' and none has a Proximity to Water attribute. NAIP shows the campground loops ~400-500 m west of the Mississippi through dense forest on a 500-ft bluff. RA photos of the six easternmost sites (47, 48, 49, 51, 52, 53, at about -91.1641 to -91.1645) show only trees and lawn; no river is visible. The river views are at the overlook and trails, not the campsites.

PIN (~440 m off): stored 42.99750,-91.16333 is north-east of the campground in the woods. The RA GIS centroid of all 57 sites is 42.99375,-91.16513 (range 42.99245-42.99577, -91.16702 to -91.16409), which matches the paved loops and pads on NAIP. Proposed location 42.99375,-91.16513.
